## Customize, Segment and Test


## Build a custom paywall— no code, no app updates 

Craft the perfect paywall for every audience and moment. Tweak a template or start with a blank canvas. Our WYSIWYG editor makes it easy for developers and marketers alike to ship in minutes.

[More on Paywalls](https://www.revenuecat.com/feature/paywalls/)

## Control who sees a paywall, when and where

Ready-made filters let you group users by any custom attribute you define; or by dimensions like country, app platform, and app version. Show your paywall when a user triggers an event, opens the app, lands on a feature and more.

## Find a winning segmentation strategy 

Run A/B/n tests to determine which paywall performs best with your target audience. Beyond just initial conversions, pre-built data visualizations and predictive analytics make it easy to understand how your tests impact your full subscription funnel.

[More about Experiments ](https://www.revenuecat.com/feature/experiments/)

## Target custom paywalls based on...

Just a few of the ways you can leverage RevenueCat Targeting to optimize your paywall segmentation strategy. 

### Onboarding
Learn what offering performs best and when - immediately upon app open or after onboarding. 

### Feature Use
First workout? First journal entry? You can show a paywall that highlights features related to their action. 

### Feature Gates
When a user tries to use a feature that is locked, you can present a personalized paywall. 

### Local Markets
Adapt the presence, duration, and pricing of offers to suit local preferences.

### Platform
iOS and Android users have distinct behaviors and preferences, as well as device capabilities.

### Custom Attributes 
Customize paywalls based on demographics, feature usage, and other user data.
